headline: Xencor Presents Phase 1 Dose Selection Data for XmAb819, a Potential First-in-Class ENPP3 x CD3 Bispecific T-Cell Engager, in Development for Patients With Advanced Clear Cell Renal Cell Carcinoma and ENPP3+ Tumors
summary: PASADENA, Calif.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Xencor, Inc. (NASDAQ:XNCR), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing engineered antibodies for the treatment of cancer and autoimmune diseases, today announced updated results from the Phase 1 study of XmAb819, an ENPP3 x CD3 T-cell engaging bispecific antibody, in patients with advanced clear cell renal cell carcinoma (ccRCC).
